from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0031: pos (0.793, 4.207), heading 180 (looking towards south)
img31 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0031.png"))
# The back of the couch is in front of the camera!
# Dark blue couch mask:
couch_mask31 = (img31[:,:,2] > img31[:,:,0] + 5) & (img31[:,:,0] > 50) & (img31[:,:,0] < 120)
ys31, xs31 = np.where(couch_mask31)
print("obs 31 couch: bottom v =", ys31.max(), "u range:", xs31.min(), xs31.max())

# Cabinet on the left in obs_0031:
# In heading 180, left is -X (east, x > 0), right is +X (west, x < 0).
# Cabinet is at x > 0, so in camera view heading 180, cabinet is to the left (u < 200).
cab_mask31 = (img31[:,:200,0] > 200) & (img31[:,:200,1] > 200) & (img31[:,:200,2] > 200)
ys_c31, xs_c31 = np.where(cab_mask31)
print("obs 31 cabinet bottom v:", ys_c31.max(), "u range:", xs_c31.min(), xs_c31.max())

def ground_to_world(u, v, X_cam, Y_cam, heading_deg):
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    z_cam = 1.55 * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    x_cam = (u - 256.0) * 1.55 / (v - 256.0)
    X_w = X_cam + z_cam * np.sin(theta) + x_cam * np.cos(theta)
    Y_w = Y_cam + z_cam * np.cos(theta) - x_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return X_w, Y_w

print("couch back edge from 31:", ground_to_world(256, ys31.max(), 0.793, 4.207, 180))
print("cabinet from 31:", ground_to_world((xs_c31.min()+xs_c31.max())/2, ys_c31.max(), 0.793, 4.207, 180))
'
